record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: Let A be an ordered Banach algebra and let \(a, b\in A\) such that \(0 \le a \le b\) . Given a spectral property (P), provide conditions which will ensure that if a satisfies (P), then \(b^n\) satisfies (P) for some natural number n . This constitutes a “converse” domination problem.

Given a spectral property (P), provide conditions which will ensure that if a satisfies (P), then \(b^n\) satisfies (P) for some natural number n . This constitutes a “converse” domination problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be a complex Banach algebra with unit, and let $A^+ \subseteq A$ be a designated algebra cone, i.e., a non-empty subset of $A$ satisfying: (i) $A^+ + A^+ \subseteq A^+$, (ii) $\lambda A^+ \subseteq A^+$ for every $\lambda \ge 0$, (iii) $A^+ \cdot A^+ \subseteq A^+$, (iv) $\mathbf{1} \in A^+$, and (v) $A^+ \cap (-A^+) = \{0\}$. The cone induces a partial order on $A$ by writing $a \le b$ iff $b - a \in A^+$; the pair $(A, A^+)$ is then called an ordered Banach algebra. 

A "spectral property" $(P)$ is a property of elements of $A$ defined in terms of the spectrum $\sigma(\cdot)$ in $A$ (for instance: having spectral radius strictly less than $1$, being quasinilpotent, having finite spectrum, being a Riesz element, being algebraic, having spectrum contained in a prescribed closed set, etc.).

Problem. Fix such a spectral property $(P)$. Identify general conditions on the ordered Banach algebra $(A, A^+)$, on the property $(P)$, and/or on elements $a, b \in A$ with $0 \le a \le b$, that guarantee the following "converse domination" implication:
$$\text{if } a \text{ satisfies } (P), \text{ then there exists } n \in \mathbb{N} \text{ such that } b^n \text{ satisfies } (P).$$
Provide such criteria for as wide a class of spectral properties $(P)$ as possible.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open research problem in the area of ordered Banach algebras. No general resolution has been located; partial results exist for specific spectral properties (e.g., spectral radius, Riesz elements) in the literature on domination in ordered Banach algebras, but the general converse domination question remains open.

status_evidence.title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Listed as an open problem concerning converse domination of spectral properties in ordered Banach algebras.
status_evidence.claim: The converse domination question is explicitly stated as an open problem.
